metaDescription: Buɗe kukin barka, ka karɓi saƙo mai kyau cikin harshen Hausa. Kyauta mara iyaka, barka da farin ciki.
headline: Fasa kukinka, ka ga kyawun yau
subline: Kowane kukin na ɗauke da saƙo mai kyau domin kai
cookieAria: Kukin da ake buɗe da hannu domin samun sabon saƙo
counter: An fasa kukin {count} a wannan zaman
footerNote: An yi shi da huzuri ga kowa.
aboutBody: Kukin Barka yana kawo saƙofofi masu kyau da farin ciki a harsuna daban-daban. Ka fasa kukin, ka karɓi saƙo mai kyau, ka sha wada — ba hasashe ba ce, huzuri kawai.
privacyBody: Ba mu tattara bayanai na mutum ba, kuma babu tsarin bibiya. Duk abin da kake gani yana kan na'urar ka ne kawai.
offlineNote: Ba ka da haɗin yanar gizo — saƙon da aka ajiye na nan tukuna!
